Shah Equity is building a strategy engine designed to ship 36+ quant strategies per year across crypto and US equities. The team you're joining: a PM with active trading book, a Head of AI Engineering building the agent infrastructure, a Quant Validation Engineer whose job is to break your code, and the founder who personally cares about every strategy that goes live.


Mission

Build, test, and deploy production trading strategies. Partner with traders to algorithmize their edge. Pair with the validation engineer on stress-testing. Ship code that runs unattended with real money.


90-Day Outcomes

  • Ship two production strategies by Day 60
  • Build or extend the backtesting framework (we already have a baseline)
  • Establish documentation and code review practices the team adopts
  • Successfully convert at least one manual trader's strategy into an algorithm

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of production quantitative development experience
  • Strong Python (mandatory). C++ or Rust a plus.
  • Backtesting framework experience you've built one or extensively used one
  • Comfort with execution platforms IB API, Alpaca, Polygon, Binance API, or equivalent
  • Demonstrable strategy you have personally built and tested (not just modified from a tutorial)
  • Statistics fluency you can talk through Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, walk-forward, and overfitting prevention

How You'll Use AI

  • Daily use of Claude or Cursor for code generation and review
  • AI-assisted backtest analysis and edge case identification
  • LLM-assisted documentation — every strategy you ship has full written documentation
  • Partnership with Head of AI Engineering on the agent layer that orchestrates strategy execution

Compensation

4.5-11 LPA based on profile depth. Performance bonus tied to strategies you ship to production AND their actual P&L. Top performers may receive equity at the operating-entity level on strategies they own end-to-end.


Work Sample (After Initial Screen)

72 hours: build a small backtest of a simple mean-reversion strategy on data we provide. Submit GitHub repository with: code, backtest results, written analysis of the strategy's weaknesses, and your approach to preventing overfitting. We grade on code quality, statistical rigor, and the honesty of your weakness analysis (if you say the strategy is perfect, we know you didn't look hard enough).

Apply by emailing recruiting@shah-equity.com.

Subject line MUST be exactly: [QUANTDEV-2026] Your Full Name — Primary Language

Example: [QUANTDEV-2026] Priya Sharma — Python

In the email body, include exactly three things, numbered:

  • 1. One GitHub or code repository link (must be public or accessible)
  • 2. One strategy you've personally built, in one sentence
  • 3. The most complex bug you debugged in a backtest, in two sentences

About the role
Job Overview
Were looking for an AI engineer with genuine depth across three areas that most people only have one of: classical ML, LLMs, and computer vision . Our problems dont fit neatly into one bucket. A single workflow might involve a vision-language model extracting fields from a 40-year-old scanned sale deed, a ranking model deciding which retrieved records matter, and an LLM-powered agent reasoning over the results to flag title risks.
Youll work on systems that are already in production and used by real customers making high-stakes property decisions - not research prototypes.


What Youll Work On
  • Document understanding at scale. Fine-tuning VLMs (Qwen, Nemotron, Kimi family models using LoRA adapters) for classification, layout analysis, and field extraction across Indian property documents - handwritten, scanned, stamped, multilingual, and frequently degraded.
  • Classical ML where it earns its keep. Ranking and retrieval (BM25 and learned rankers), entity resolution across noisy government records, fraud/anomaly detection, and calibration of model confidence for legal-grade outputs.
  • LLM agents in production. Improving our conversational agents for land-records search and title diligence - tool design, context management, evaluation harnesses, and cost/latency optimization.
  • Evaluation and data infrastructure. Designing annotation taxonomies, building eval sets that reflect real document distributions, and closing the loop from production failures back into training data.
What Were Looking For
  • 6 10 years building ML systems in production, with shipped work across at least two of: classical ML, LLMs/NLP, computer vision.
  • Strong fundamentals - you can reason about why a model fails, not just swap in a bigger one. Comfort with the full lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight models ( LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, preference optimization ) or training CV/document models (detection, layout, OCR pipelines).
  • Practical LLM engineering: prompt and context design, structured/constrained outputs, RAG, agent tool design, building evals that actually predict production quality.
  • Solid Python and the engineering discipline to write code teammates can build on. Experience with PyTorch and the modern inference stack ( vLLM or similar) is a plus.
  • Pragmatism. You pick the simplest approach that solves the problem - sometimes thats a gradient-boosted tree, sometimes its an 8B VLM with constrained decoding.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Indic languages, OCR for degraded documents, or multilingual NLP.
  • Work on agentic systems, multi-step tool use, or LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Exposure to legal, fintech, or other high-stakes domains where correctness and provenance matter.
  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling or published applied work.


Your First 90 Days
Days 1 30: Ground truth. Ship a small improvement to a production model or eval in week one. Read real documents and real transcripts - sale deeds, ECs, agent conversations - until you understand why this data breaks naive approaches. Own one document types extraction quality end to end.
Days 31 60: Own a model surface. Take full ownership of one pipeline - say, an extraction adapter for a major state or the retrieval/ranking layer - including its eval set, error analysis, and a measurable quality lift youve shipped to production.
Days 61 90: Shape the roadmap. Propose and begin executing a meaningful bet - a new adapter architecture, a better eval harness, a classical-ML component that cuts cost or error - backed by evidence from your first 60 days. By now your judgment should be influencing what the team builds next, not just how.


Why This Role
  • Frontier applied-AI problems with no playbook - nobody has solved document intelligence for Indian land records.
  • Direct impact: your models decide whether a familys property purchase is safe.
  • Small, senior team with high ownership; youll shape architecture, not just implement tickets.
  • Backed by Y Combinator and top investors, with real revenue and real customers.
Why Join Landeed
  • High-Impact Role : Shape the AI backbone of a cutting-edge real estate platform that transforms how millions access property information.
  • Fast-Growing Startup : Join a dynamic, collaborative environment in Hyderabad, where your ideas and expertise will be valued.
  • Competitive Compensation : Receive a fixed salary plus equity , aligning your success with the company s growth.
  • Professional Growth : Work with talented peers and stay at the frontier of AI/ML innovations in NLP and information retrieval.


About the interview
We move fast - the full loop takes 5-7 days, and well give you a decision within 48 hours of your final round.
  • Intro call (30 min). Mutual fit, your background, what youre looking for. Well walk you through the problem space.
  • Technical deep-dive (60 min). A past ML system you shipped, interrogated properly: data, modeling choices, failure modes, what youd redo. Were probing for depth and honesty, not buzzwords.
  • Work sample (take-home or paired, your choice, ~3 hrs). A scoped problem on real (anonymized) property-document data e.g., design and partially implement an extraction + eval approach.
  • System design + eval round (60 min). Design a production pipeline for a Landeed problem end to end, including how youd measure it. Expect pushback.
  • Founder conversation (45 min). Values, ambition, and your questions about where the company is going.


About Landeed

Evaluate and introduce new storage technologies aligned to specific workload demands

products

jobDescription:
Senior Business Analyst

Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:
  • Reviewing payer contracts, amendments, and fee schedules
  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues
  • Calling out false positives and explaining why something is not a true issue. If something looks technically correct but operationally wrong, you are expected to stop it.
  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.
  1. Act as the RCM Counterweight in Vendor Engagements. You will actively participate in vendor evaluations, technical reviews, and edge-case discussions. You will:
  • Ask uncomfortable but necessary questions
  • Spot hand-wavy answers around contracts or EDI
  • Distinguish between can build, has built, and is guessing
  • This role is critical to holding vendors accountable and ensuring delivery meets operational standards.
  1. Help Carry the Long-Term Platform Vision Forward. While the MVP starts with underpayments, the platform is designed to evolve toward:
  • Broader reimbursement correctness (denials, old AR, charge capture)
  • Recommendation intelligence and outcome monitoring
  • Selective automation with AI agents
  • Contract renegotiation insights. You will help ensure core data models are reusable, intelligence is generalized, and we t hard-code short term assumptions that block long-term evolution.

Candidate Requirements

Experience Domain Expertise

  • 6-10+ years in health care RCM revenue integrity, payer contracts, payment analysis, denials, or A/R
  • Experience working with ambiguous or conflicting data
  • Deep knowledge of payer contracts and fee schedules percent of Medicare, lesser-of, MCO products, modifier rules, effective dates
  • Deep knowledge of the RCM data ecosystem claims, remittances, fee schedules, industry benchmarks, regulatory references, and how they connect
  • Deep expertise in at least one RCM process area (appeals, denials, A/R follow-up, payment posting) you ll help design how AI agents execute these work flows

Judgment Mindset

  • Strong judgment in gray areas where contracts, data, and payer behavior don t line up
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions including those from engineers and vendors
  • Comfortable saying this would never happen in production
  • Builder mentality: you like shaping systems, not just running reports
  • Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

  • SQL proficiency ability to query data, validate outputs, build test cases
  • Advanced Excel pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, large data set manipulation
  • Comfortable working with raw data (CSV, JSON, EDI extracts)
  • Able to explain domain logic clearly to engineers you t need to code, but you must understand how logic translates into systems

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with lab billing (CLFS) or physician billing (PFS) ideally both
  • Background in underpayment recovery, contract audits, or payer disputes
  • Familiarity with Medicare fee schedules and locality adjustments (GPCI)
  • Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
  • Prior experience in a startup or product development environment

jobDescription:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for financial planning, accounting operations, statutory compliance, taxation, budgeting, audits, MIS reporting, cash flow management, and financial strategy. The role requires strong commercial acumen, leadership capabilities, and experience supporting a high-growth technology business.

The candidate will work closely with the leadership team to provide financial insights, strengthen internal controls, ensure regulatory compliance, and support strategic decision-making.

Job Summary

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee end-to-end accounting operations, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Payroll Accounting, and Revenue Accounting.
  • Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close.
  • Prepare accurate financial statements in accordance with applicable Accounting Standards (Ind AS/IFRS, as applicable).
  • Review journal entries, reconciliations, and financial records to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Present financial reports and business insights to senior management.

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • Monitor budgets and analyse variances against actual performance.
  • Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
  • Provide profitability analysis by product, customer, and business unit.
  • Deliver actionable MIS reports and dashboards for management review.

Taxation & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with direct and indirect tax regulations, including Income Tax, GST, TDS, and other statutory requirements.
  • Coordinate tax assessments, notices, and regulatory filings.
  • Ensure timely filing of statutory returns and compliance reports.

Audit & Internal Controls

  • Manage statutory, internal, tax, and secretarial audits.
  • Develop and strengthen internal financial controls and risk management processes.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement in financial policies, SOPs, and control frameworks.

Treasury & Cash Flow Management

  • Monitor cash flow, working capital, and liquidity.
  • Optimize banking relationships and treasury operations.
  • Manage investments, fund utilization, and payment planning.
  • Support fundraising, due diligence, and investor reporting activities, where applicable.

Cross-functional Partnering & Financial Guidance

Finance Transformation & Automation

Loyalty Juggernaut is seeking a Product Manager to identify, validate, launch, and scale new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled offerings. We design and run loyalty and customer-engagement programs for some of the world's most recognized brands. Growth doesn't only come from the platform - it comes from new offerings - new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled practices that clients need before anyone has packaged them. This role finds such opportunities and turns them into real businesses.

As a Product Manager in the Loyalty Performance Management (LPM) team, you will own the full lifecycle - from an initial idea or market signal through research, business case, offer design, pilot, commercialization, and practice development. After launch, you will act as the business owner for the incubated practice - setting its roadmap, sharpening the proposition and delivery model, watching commercial performance, and building the repeatability it needs to become a standalone unit.

This is not a traditional software product management role. It blends market strategy, services design, product marketing, commercial ownership, and venture incubation. You are as comfortable building a market landscape and modeling unit economics as you are shaping a client-ready offer, creating sales enablement, and leading cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities

Opportunity discovery & market validation

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new-service ideas.
  • Conduct structured market, customer, category, and competitor research.
  • Define the ideal customer profile, economic buyer, priority use cases, customer pain points and desired outcomes.
  • Lead interviews and working sessions with clients, prospects, sales, delivery teams, product leaders, subject-matter experts, and partners.

Business case, pricing & investment recommendation

  • Build decision-grade business cases that connect market opportunity, strategic fit, client value, investment requirements, risks, and expected business impact.
  • Define pricing, packaging, contract structure, and monetization options - fixed fees, subscriptions, usage or outcome-based fees, revenue share, and hybrid models.
  • Translate assumptions into an executive recommendation and a clear investment ask; track actual performance against the approved case and update the forecast as evidence improves.

Service product design & productization

  • Turn a validated opportunity into a repeatable, sellable offer with a defined customer, outcome, scope, deliverables, methodology, timeline, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design the end-to-end service blueprint: client journey, discovery and design activities, delivery workflows, roles and RACI, governance, data and technology requirements, quality controls, SLAs, and KPI framework.
  • Translate service requirements into a prioritized roadmap for platform, data, analytics, automation, and internal tooling in partnership with product and engineering.

GTM & sales enablement

  • Partner with Marketing to define the name, positioning, value proposition, audience, messaging architecture, launch plan, and campaign strategy.
  • Create client-ready sales materials: offering decks, one-pagers, vertical use cases, executive narratives, case studies, ROI tools, proposal content, demo stories, objection handling, and competitive battlecards.
  • Translate complex capabilities into clear stories that connect the customer requirement, the service or solution design, the commercial logic, and the measurable outcome.

Launch, roadmap & practice incubation

  • Own cross-functional launch readiness: milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, enablement, delivery capacity, operational controls, measurement, and executive reporting.
  • Maintain the post-launch roadmap and prioritized backlog across proposition, methodology, commercial model, sales enablement, delivery operations, technology, analytics, and partner ecosystem.
  • Create the operating cadence for the practice: performance dashboards, pipeline and delivery reviews, roadmap decisions, client feedback loops, and quarterly business reviews.

Graduation to a standalone unit

  • Prepare the scale plan: market focus, product and service roadmap, P&L and forecast, organization design, hiring profile, partner model, governance, and investment needs.
  • Transition the practice to its permanent leader with clear ownership, documented IP and processes, an active roadmap, trained teams, customer and pipeline context, and a complete performance baseline.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience. MBA / PGDM would be ideal.
  • 5+ years in services product management, consulting offer development, strategy, professional services, product marketing, corporate innovation, venture building, or a closely related role.
  • Demonstrated success taking at least one B2B service, solution, or practice from concept through launch and into measurable commercial growth.
  • Direct experience building business cases and financial models used to inform real investment decisions - not academic exercises.
  • Experience presenting solutions and recommendations to senior client and internal stakeholders, including executives.
  • Strong market research and customer discovery skills, with the ability to turn incomplete signals into a structured point of view and testable hypotheses.
  • Commercial and financial fluency - business-case development, pricing and packaging, scenario modeling, unit economics, margin, forecasting, and investment recommendations.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Shared Data/ODSP Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on-shift technical delivery for tenant-to-tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics-driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre-checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third-party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign-off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long-running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

  • Delivered at least one production tenant-to-tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands-on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Teams-associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi-geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS-102) or SharePoint specialization, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises.
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action-oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re-run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign-off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate we re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Principal AI Security Specialist to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to Ron Burkett. As enterprises race to adopt generative AI, Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security. In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection to serve as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 executives. As our premier technical authority, you will help customers confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure.

What you ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close

  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage

  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force

  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner, letting your passion for the mission fuel a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving candor with clarity and respect.

  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers to anchor decisions in solving real-world problems.

  • You are driven by innovation, possessing a deep curiosity for how things work and an energy for solving complex technical challenges to accelerate secure transformation.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them

  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

title: Microsoft Relationship Manager
jobDescription:
There is an immediate need for a Microsoft Relationship Manager located in India (Delhi NCR or Chennai preferred; open to candidates across India) at SupraITS. If you re a senior professional who truly understands Microsoft partner programs and wants to own a direct Microsoft relationship end to end, then this position is for you.

ABOUT SUPRA ITS

Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.

Supra ITS provides a full spectrum of IT solutions, including server and network management, private cloud, disaster recovery, service desk support, and advanced security services. With a security-first approach and SLA-driven commitments, Supra ITS takes complete ownership of IT services, allowing clients to focus on growth while ensuring uninterrupted operations.

A vendor of established track record, Supra ITS is dedicated to long-term client success through tailored, scalable IT solutions. Canon Canada s strategic investment in Supra ITS strengthens this commitment by integrating Canon s cutting-edge technologies with Supra s agile IT services. This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.

TEAM OVERVIEW

This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra has become a Microsoft Direct (Tier-1) CSP Partner and is investing in its Microsoft practice across Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Copilot. You will be part of a growing team and an evolving company, working closely with leadership in Canada and India.

YOU ARE!

You are someone who knows the Microsoft partner ecosystem inside out. You have lived in Partner Center, you know how CSP direct billing works, and you can explain incentives, designations, and co-sell motions without opening a manual. You take pride in turning Microsoft s programs into real, measurable business value.

You are a relationship builder. You are comfortable engaging Microsoft account teams, distributors, and internal executives alike. You chase actions, keep cadences alive, and make sure nothing Microsoft offers Supra is left on the table.

You re not just joining a team-you re becoming the face of Supra s Microsoft alliance, in a company that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to excellence.

The Microsoft Relationship Manager is responsible for owning and growing Supra s direct Microsoft relationship following our transition to Microsoft Direct (Tier-1) CSP Partner status. This role owns the complete operating rhythm around Partner Center, CSP program compliance, Microsoft Commerce Incentives, co-op/MDF funding, Solutions Partner designations, certifications, co-sell motions, and executive reporting. The Microsoft Relationship Manager acts as the bridge between Microsoft, distributors, and Supra s sales, technical, finance, and leadership teams. The role reports to the Director of Product Management, based in Canada.

This is a hybrid role based in India. Delhi NCR or Chennai is preferred; strong candidates from other locations across India will also be considered. As the reporting manager is based in Canada, this role requires regular working-hours overlap with morning EST (approximately 6:30 PM - 10:30 PM IST).

Key Responsibilities Microsoft Alliance Relationship Management

  • Act as Supra s single point of contact for Microsoft - partner development managers, field sellers, and distributor/indirect contacts.
  • Build and maintain a Microsoft contact map, engagement calendar, and escalation log.
  • Prepare and run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with Microsoft, including agendas, pre-reads, action trackers, and follow-ups.
  • Represent Supra in Microsoft partner events, program briefings, and community forums.

Partner Center Direct CSP Operations

  • Own day-to-day Partner Center administration: user access, role assignments, benefits activation, program enrollments, and support tickets.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Microsoft Direct CSP (direct-bill) requirements, including revenue thresholds, support plans, and security requirements (MFA, GDAP, CPOR/PAL associations).
  • Manage relationships and commercial terms with distributors and Microsoft for licensing motions, including New Commerce Experience (NCE) transitions.

Incentives, Funding Rebates

  • Own end-to-end management of Microsoft Commerce Incentives: enrollment, eligibility, claims, documentation, payout tracking, and finance reconciliation.
  • Identify and capture co-op/MDF funds, workshop funding, and other Microsoft partner investments.
  • Maintain an incentives and funding tracker with clear visibility of earned, claimed, pending, and missed amounts.

Designations, Certifications Enablement

  • Drive progress towards Solutions Partner designations and specializations across Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Business Applications as applicable.
  • Maintain the certification tracker and internal skilling calendar; coordinate monthly sales and technical enablement for Modern Work, Security, Azure, Copilot, licensing, and Partner Center workflows.
  • Work with delivery and HR teams to plan certification paths that protect designation renewals.

Co-sell Go-to-Market

  • Manage co-sell readiness: referrals, solution listings, marketplace presence, and Microsoft field alignment.
  • Track co-sell opportunities, campaign activity, solution plays, and Microsoft-funded customer workshops.
  • Partner with sales leadership to convert Microsoft programs into pipeline and revenue.

Executive Reporting Governance

Maintain a concise monthly executive dashboard and action tracker covering, e.g.:

  • Incentive earnings, claims, and payout status.
  • Solutions Partner designation and partner capability score progress.
  • Certification and enablement completion.
  • Co-op/MDF funding utilization.
  • Co-sell pipeline and referral activity.
  • Open Microsoft actions and escalations.

Qualifications Skills

Education Experience

  • Bachelor s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in the Microsoft partner ecosystem - partner/alliance management, partner programs, CSP operations, or vendor management at an MSP, CSP, LSP, distributor, or Microsoft itself.
  • Hands-on experience operating a Microsoft CSP practice; direct-bill (Tier-1) experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of managing incentives, funding, and designation programs with measurable results.

Microsoft Program Knowledge

  • Deep working knowledge of Microsoft Partner Center, the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program, Solutions Partner designations, and specializations.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Commerce Incentives, co-op/MDF, CPOR/PAL, co-sell, and marketplace programs.
  • Solid grasp of Microsoft licensing (CSP/NCE) and the Modern Work, Security, Azure, and Copilot portfolios.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and reporting skills (Excel / Power BI) with disciplined documentation and follow-through.
  • Self-driven owner s mindset - comfortable running a cadence, chasing actions, and working across time zones.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

About TYLsemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
  • Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.


Culture Team: How We Work No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

  • No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.
Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  • US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
  • India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore
Move Fast, Ship Real Products

Were not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. Were building to win.

What We Value
  • Ownership mindset. Youre not here to execute someone elses roadmap. Youre here to define it.
  • Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesnt fly here.
  • Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people whove shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
  • Low ego, high standards. We dont care about titles or politics. We care about results.
The Ask

If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

Were asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Heres why you should:

  • The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what were building.
  • The team has done this before. Weve built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isnt our first rodeo.
  • The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
  • The work is consequential. Youre not optimizing someones ad click-through rate. Youre building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

We are looking for a DFT Engineer with solid hands-on experience to own key aspects of DFT implementation and verification for advanced SoC designs. You will drive DFT features to achieve high test coverage while optimizing for test time and power.

  • Develop and implement DFT architecture including scan insertion, compression, and hierarchical DFT.
  • Generate and optimize ATPG patterns for various fault models (stuck-at, transition, path delay, etc.) and perform failure diagnosis.

  • Analyze coverage metrics and improve test quality.

  • 4-7 years of experience in DFT for SoC/ASIC designs.
  • Strong proficiency in ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, scan compression,BSCAN and IJTAG.

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help build the systems that make our AI agents powerful, reliable, and useful in real-world cybersecurity environments. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, distributed systems, and applied AI. You will build the backend infrastructure that powers our agents while also working directly on agent behavior, improving how agents reason, use tools, retrieve context, handle failures, and complete complex tasks. The goal isn't simply to build models or backend services in isolation. It's to turn AI capabilities into dependable production systems that solve real customer problems. title: Software Engineer (Platform/Backend) - ClickHouse
jobDescription:
We are Omnissa.

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions-including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security Compliance-into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our core values-Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value-were growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If youre passionate about shaping the future of work, wed love to hear from you.

What is the opportunity

You have an analytical mind and a passion for the craft of software engineering, and you love solving problems and learning new things. Technologies come and go, but that excites you because of the endless possibilities it creates.

You are looking for an opportunity to work for a company whose software is utilized by every Fortune 500 company and significantly impacts every industry. You want to be a part of a collaborative environment whose teams care about the product they are creating, how they create it, and the impact it has on customers business objectives.

As a Member of Technical Staff, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable, reusable, testable code that expands our platforms core services and capabilities, while also enhancing their scalability and resilience.

  • Identify and troubleshoot performance, scalability, and code quality issues across application, ingestion, and data layers.

  • Take ownership of engineering initiatives and promote a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

  • Actively engage with various stakeholders within Engineering, Product Management, Security Engineering, and External Partners as needed to define and deliver the required solution.

  • Operate with a Dev own quality mindset, participating in all stages of software development-requirements, design, coding, test automation, debugging, deployment, and production support.

  • Perform code reviews and ensure coding best practices.

What will you bring to Omnissa

You are expected to have strong experience in the following:

  • Deep hands-on experience with ClickHouse table design for analytical workloads: sorting key and sparse primary key design; partition strategy; data skipping indexes; materialized views for pre-aggregation; codec and compression selection per column type; and TTL policies for retention and data tiering.

  • Proven experience operating ClickHouse in production: distributed cluster design with ClickHouse Keeper; sharding and Distributed table architecture; high-throughput ingestion patterns; query profiling; diagnosing merge backpressure, part explosion, and mutation storms; memory and thread tuning via server/user profiles; storage tiering with storage policies; and monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana using ClickHouse-native metrics.

  • Familiarity with ClickHouse projections, query result caching, RBAC and row-level security, and experience managing version upgrades across breaking changes.

  • Strong understanding of analytical data modeling and trade-offs between transactional and analytical storage patterns.

  • Experience building or supporting high-throughput ingestion pipelines involving streaming systems, asynchronous processing, batch loading, or change-data-capture style workflows.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, especially where it is used as a transactional state store alongside an analytical database.

  • High proficiency and experience in Unix/Linux platforms.

  • Strong working experience with C#, Go, and Docker.

  • Good understanding of and experience in software architecture and high-performance, scalable distributed systems.

  • Solid grasp of application architecture, networking, security, reliability, and scalability concepts.

  • Strong DevOps experience, including building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

  • Collaboration skills for working with distributed teams (Omnissa has teams globally).

  • 2-10 years of experience in software engineering.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent technical training

Additionally, the following skills and qualifications will help you stand out :

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka, including event-driven or streaming architectures beyond basic pub/sub.

  • Experience designing systems for non-blocking ingestion, asynchronous processing, internal queueing, file-based loaders, or decoupled write pipelines.

  • Experience with large-scale JOIN-heavy analytical workloads and query patterns that require predictable low-latency responses.

  • Comprehensive knowledge and work experience with any or all of the following technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and OpenSearch.

  • Strong foundation in Linux file systems, memory, and multi-threading.

  • Experience maintaining a large number of production deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud solutions and managed cloud services.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as OS (Linux and Windows), Network, Database, Server, Storage, etc.

Location and Work Model

Location: Bangalore, India Atlanta, USA
Work Model: Hybrid (3 days in-office, 2 days remote). Candidates must reside within a 1-hour commute radius of the office.
Travel Expectations: Up to 20% travel, domestic or international, based on business needs.

Team and Leadership

You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager based in Canada (Eastern Time), a seasoned leader with more than 20 years of experience in engineering and team building. Since joining VMware EUC, he has expanded a key engineering group, retained top talent, and added another flagship product to the portfolio.

The team culture emphasizes:

  • Trust and collaboration - building strong, respectful relationships

  • Customer commitment - delivering value and successful outcomes for users

  • Transparency and communication - encouraging open dialogue and clarity

  • Work-life balance - supporting flexibility and fulfillment at work

  • Assist in pre-sales activities and create supportive case studies and portfolios.

  • Proficiency in Google Ads dashboard and other tools like Google Data Studio, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues related to ad delivery, tracking, or account setup.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and optimize campaigns based on insights.

  • Continuous education through industry-recognized programs, webinars, and workshops to stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies (preferred).

Job Summary

The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.

To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.

In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.

You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.

Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,

  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.

Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.

Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.

Environmental Working Conditions

Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.

Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.

Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.

Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform. Our mission is to power the world s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. We serve 19,000 restaurants globally.

Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table.

About The Role

We are seeking a seasoned data professional with experience in fast-paced environments to lead our data infrastructure development and governance efforts. This role will report to the Director of Data Strategy within the Data, Strategy, and Integrations organization, with a strong dotted-line alignment to Product - ensuring priorities are directly driven by the product roadmap.

This role is critical to maintaining and accelerating the foundation of Global Dining s Product analytics and AI capabilities. You will build and scale the unified data architecture that underpins the product roadmap- owning pipelines, data models, and reusable datasets that directly accelerate product initiatives and data operationalization across the enterprise. This work ensures the continued evolution of a forward-looking AI strategy by strengthening the underlying data platform required to support it.

As an analytics infrastructure subject matter expert, your work will focus on proactively identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements to enhance the efficiency, performance, and reliability of our data pipelines, while improving scalability and maintainability. It will include optimizing existing code and data architecture, engineering new integrations, and creating reusable, governed datasets that enable faster product development at scale.

As a governance subject matter expert, your work will focus on driving data security and leading the regulatory and contractual compliance initiatives across our infrastructure. You will partner with Compliance and Privacy teams to complete Information Security assessments, ensure alignment between third party services and Amex requirements, and coordinate service contract renewals - maintaining the integrity and reliability of our analytics ecosystem.

Finally, as a member of a lean data team, you will oversee a wide range of responsibilities, including partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to identify key data initiatives aligned to product priorities, managing project intake, and developing training programs to enhance self-service data capabilities across the organization.

We are seeking a motivated and driven DFT Engineers to join our semiconductor design team. In this role, you will take direct ownership of implementing and verifying Design-for-Test (DFT) features across complex SoCs and ASICs. You will drive tasks independently to ensure high test coverage, manufacturability, and first-pass silicon quality.This is a great opportunity to build world-class chiplets and work on cutting-edge silicon architectures.

Good to Have

About the Role


We believe great user experiences begin with understanding business problems before designing solutions. We are looking for a proactive, analytical professional who enjoys engaging with diverse stakeholder groups, simplifying complexity and translating ideas into practical, user-centred digital solutions.

As part of our Product & Business Experience practice, you will independently own UX solutioning activities across assigned client engagements with minimal supervision. Our work spans enterprise applications, corporate websites, digital platforms, data portals and product initiatives, requiring the ability to adapt to diverse business domains and project types. You will lead discovery, facilitate stakeholder discussions, define solution direction, guide visual designers and collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance business goals, user needs and technical feasibility.

AI is an integral part of how we work. We expect leads to actively leverage AI for research, ideation, conceptualisation, solution exploration, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and delivery, while continuously evaluating emerging AI capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


Business Discovery & Solutioning

  • Independently lead discovery workshops to understand business objectives, user needs and operational challenges.
  • Bring together diverse stakeholder groups to build a shared understanding of business problems and solution direction.
  • Analyse business processes and translate discussions into clear requirements, decisions and actionable next steps.
  • Help establish realistic scope and priorities while balancing business goals, user experience and engineering feasibility.

Experience Design

  • Translate business problems into intuitive digital experiences across a variety of project types.
  • Define experience direction through user journeys, workflows, information architecture, conceptual wireframes and interactive prototypes.
  • Provide functional guidance to visual designers while preserving business intent, usability and technical feasibility.

Stakeholder Facilitation

  • Confidently engage business users, SMEs, engineering teams, project managers and leadership.
  • Facilitate discussions, build consensus and constructively challenge assumptions where appropriate.
  • Own the UX solutioning workstream for assigned projects while collaborating with practice leadership on larger strategic initiatives.

Delivery Excellence

  • Support engineering teams during implementation to ensure the intended experience is realised.
  • Contribute reusable UX assets, templates and design patterns, and actively share project learnings to strengthen the practice.
  • Continuously improve delivery quality through structured thinking and knowledge sharing.

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Use AI daily for research, ideation, conceptualisation, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and productivity.
  • Stay current with emerging AI capabilities, including agentic workflows where appropriate, and evaluate how they can improve delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • 48 years of experience delivering UX solutions for enterprise applications, websites, portals, digital products or similar digital initiatives.
  • Strong business analysis, solutioning and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently own assigned projects while recognising when to seek guidance.

  • Strong communication, facilitation and presentation skills.

  • Comfortable using AI as a core part of everyday work and keen to adopt emerging AI capabilities.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and committed to continuous learning.

title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

About Varaha

Varaha is the largest carbon removal developer in Asia, working with more than 200,000 smallholder farmers. Trusted by brands like Google and Microsoft, we combine an exceptional team with deeply impactful work. Through regenerative agriculture, afforestation, and biochar, our projects remove carbon while simultaneously restoring soils, protecting biodiversity, and improving livelihoods far beyond our project boundaries. We are a profitable, rapidly growing company backed by premier global private equity and top-tier venture capital. Our roots are in India, and our impact is global.

The Opportunity

Varaha runs the largest smallholder soil carbon project in the world and has closed the largest regenerative agriculture deals in the market. Behind that sits a measurement stack built on multiple bio-geo-chemical models, remote sensing, and machine learning, calibrated against physical soil samples from the field by a world-class science team. Buyers, auditors, and funders all want the same thing from it: a clear, sourced account of what we measured and why it holds.

You are the commercial teams technical authority on regenerative agriculture and afforestation, and the person who turns several hundred thousand hectares of fieldwork into documents a Chief Sustainability Officer can act on. Regenerative agriculture comes first. Afforestation and reforestation follow.

We are deliberately open on background. Agronomists from agri-conglomerates, people who have run contract farming or sustainable sourcing programmes at scale, agri-input and agri-tech technical leads, remote sensing specialists, and programme leads who have delivered smallholder work across large geographies all fit. What matters is that you have stood in a field, know what the data from it can and cannot support, and write clearly.

  • Build the answer library so the same question is never answered from scratch twice and our language stays consistent across proposals, contracts, and project documents.

  • Turn data into claims. Read agronomy datasets and remote sensing outputs and convert them into short statements we can defend in front of a buyer.
