Job Title: AI Engineer

Company: Outscale Partners

Location: Hybrid | Experience: 7 8 Years | Experience in AI: 4 5 Years | Openings: 2



About Outscale Partners

Outscale Partners (formerly AMH Services) is a Gurgaon, India-based global capability center (GCC) and strategic business solutions partner for the Argenbright Group, founded in 2022. It offers AI-enabled services in HR, finance, IT, legal, and customer support, focusing on rapid, scalable growth for enterprises



Role Summary

Reporting to the Senior AI Consultant, the AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and operate AI systems across Unifi Service s enterprise platforms.

The role spans the entire AI lifecycle use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.



Core Responsibilities

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.

Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.

Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.

Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.

Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.



Must-Have (Non-Negotiable) Skills Experience

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.

Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).

Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.

Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.

Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.

Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.

Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of LLMOps MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.

Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.

Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc



Language Documentation Expectations

All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.

AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.

Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.

Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.




What We Offer

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience migrating Teams associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS 102) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises .

  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

title: Senior UCIe Verification Engineer
jobDescription:
Introduction

We are looking for a Senior UCIe Verification Engineer with strong experience in SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification of high-speed interconnects and SoC subsystems. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in verifying UCIe (Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express) IP and should have contributed to at least 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs. The role involves developing reusable verification environments, protocol compliance verification, subsystem/SoC integration, and driving verification closure.


About Edgecortix

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high efficiency silicon on chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-design principle and the Dynamic Neural Accelerator AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bring the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices. Our operations are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with offices in Singapore, Virginia, California in the US. In addition, we are starting a new Design Center in India, located in Hyderabad.

The Team

As an engineering driven company we are working to define and solve the hardest problems in AI including computer vision, speech, and natural language, geared towards real-time capabilities on small to medium form factor devices. We originated out of multiple years of research, as such at our core we value learning, intellectual curiosity, and self-starters. We have the ambitious goal of enabling cloud-level performance with significantly better energy-efficiency for AI inference at the edge.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans for UCIe IP, subsystems, and SoC integration.
  • Build reusable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Develop constrained-random and directed test scenarios to verify UCIe functionality and protocol compliance.
  • Verify UCIe protocol features, including:
    Link initialization and training
    Sideband communication
    Adapter layer
    Protocol layer
    Data transfer and flow control
    Link power management
    Error detection and recovery
    Reset and initialization sequences
  • Verify interoperability between UCIe and upper-layer protocols such as PCIe, CXL, or streaming interfaces.
  • Develop UVM agents, scoreboards, monitors, protocol checkers, and functional coverage models.
  • Write and debug SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for protocol compliance and interface checks.
  • Perform coverage analysis and drive functional and code coverage closure.
  • Debug RTL, protocol, and testbench issues using simulation and waveform analysis.
  • Support gate-level simulations, regression execution, and silicon bring-up activities.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, DFT, firmware, physical design, and validation teams throughout the product development cycle.



Desired Qualifications:

  • 6-12 years of experience in functional verification using SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Strong experience in developing complete UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Good understanding of UCIe architecture and protocol.
  • Experience verifying high-speed serial interfaces or chiplet interconnects.
  • Strong understanding of:
    AXI4
    High-speed protocol verification
    Clock domain crossings (CDC)
    Reset domain crossings (RDC)
    Protocol compliance verification
  • Experience with constrained-random, assertion-based, and coverage-driven verification methodologies.
  • Strong experience writing SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA).
  • Experience with gate-level simulation and timing-aware verification.
  • Excellent RTL and protocol debugging skills.
  • Experience in verifying die-to-die interfaces or chiplet-based architectures.
  • Experience with subsystem and SoC-level verification.
  • Experience with emulator-based verification platforms.
  • Exposure to Formal Verification techniques.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • SoC Experience
    Hands-on experience in 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs.
    Experience integrating UCIe subsystems into complex SoCs.
    Exposure to boot flows, clock/reset architecture, power management, and chiplet integration.
    Experience collaborating with firmware and post-silicon validation teams during bring-up and debug.

What s in it for you

Make a difference: you will have the opportunity to join a well-funded fabless AI semiconductor startup that is disrupting the AI software and hardware co-design space. Be an integral part of its growth and momentum.

Benefits and Perks

  • Highly competitive salary and stock options
  • Flex work time
  • Top-tier employee benefits

jobDescription:
Job Summary

You are the offshore specialist leader for tenant to tenant endpoint migration readiness and escalation support. You guide Scale squads and the Factory through device migration sequencing, Intune re enrolment impacts, Autopilot/join state considerations and remediation patterns. This role is critical to avoiding mass disruption: endpoint readiness issues can block user productivity at wave cutovers, so your job is to standardise solutions, reduce repeat failures and provide rapid escalation leadership during cutover windows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide endpoint readiness guidance and risk assessments for migration waves.
  • Act as escalation authority for complex device migration failures and root cause analysis.
  • Define and maintain runbooks for common remediation scenarios (enrolment failures, compliance issues, profile/application targeting problems).
  • Coordinate dependencies with Identity and Security teams (device trust and access controls).
  • Support cutover events with rapid triage and stabilisation leadership.
  • Maintain known issues and fixes catalogue; reduce recurring defects through standard patterns.
  • Provide validation criteria and evidence standards for endpoint readiness and post migration acceptance.
  • Support the Factory discipline leads by improving troubleshooting playbooks and telemetry standards.
  • Provide reporting inputs on failure categories, remediation throughput and readiness health metrics.
  • Align to one region and adjust working patterns to support regional cutovers.

Who You Are

Must Have

  • Delivered tenant to tenant endpoint migration work in production (Intune/Windows specialism mandatory).
  • Deep Intune operational expertise and troubleshooting competence.
  • Practical understanding of device join state and provisioning concepts relevant to tenant transitions.
  • Proven ability to create runbooks, validation steps and known fix playbooks for repeatable execution.
  • Willingness to align working hours to regional cutovers (early/late calls) and support extended hours when required.
  • Strong documentation discipline and evidence first practices.
  • Ability to coach engineers and improve delivery maturity at pace.

Good to Have

  • Experience with workstation/profile migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) and hands on understanding of real world constraints.
  • Microsoft certification alignment relevant to endpoint management (or equivalent experience).
  • PowerShell scripting for diagnostics, readiness reporting and bulk remediation.
  • Experience with large, globally distributed device estates and remote workforce constraints.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Calm escalation leadership in user impacting cutover events.
  • Clear communicator: logs, evidence and precise guidance rather than guesswork.
  • Strong coaching and collaboration behaviours across shifts and teams.
  • Risk and dependency management mindset; prevents avoidable disruption.
  • High integrity around access/security and change discipline.
  • Strong written communication: tickets, handovers, playbooks.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Lower endpoint migration failure rate and improved first time success.
  • MTTR for endpoint migration blockers during cutovers.
  • Repeat issue reduction via improved runbooks and known fix catalogues.
  • Evidence completion rate for endpoint acceptance checks.
  • Readiness pass rate for endpoint components at wave entry.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

Scale teams operate as a cohesive unit within a follow the sun project delivery model. Each scale team works an 8 hour shift, scheduled across a 24 hour global working day. Structured handovers between scale teams are mandatory and cutover periods may require rota flexibility.

title: Monitoring and Observability Engineer
tagsAndSkills: business requirements,administration,ai,anomaly detection,cloud platforms,application monitoring,ansible,apache kafka
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Monitoring and Observability Engineer to be part of our monitoring and observability initiatives. This role requires to implement monitoring standards and KPIs with hands-on technical expertise in building and maintaining robust observability infrastructure. You will work on key technologies and implement best practices to enhance the user experience across our monitoring ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and manage KPI/Metrics standards and best practices for the organization, ensuring consistency and measurability
  • Deploy monitoring solutions using industry-leading tools including Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, and SolarWinds
  • Develop and implement Kafka-based event streaming and monitoring pipelines for real-time data collection and analysis
  • Integrate and manage AI monitoring capabilities to enable intelligent alerting, anomaly detection, and predictive insights
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation and runbooks for monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting procedures, and operational playbooks
  • Develop custom scripts and automation in bash, Python, or Go to enhance monitoring capabilities and reduce operational overhead
  • Establish and refine SLAs, SLOs, and alerting thresholds based on business requirements and operational data
  • Conduct performance analysis and optimization of monitoring infrastructure to reduce latency and improve system reliability
  • Collaborate with DevOps, Platform, and Application teams to ensure comprehensive observability across the entire stack
  • Stay current with emerging monitoring and observability trends, tools, and technologies
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing metrics, gathering feedback, and implementing enhancements to the user experience

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of professional experience in monitoring, observability, systems engineering, or DevOps roles
  • Proven experience in monitoring or infrastructure domains
  • Deep hands-on expertise with opensource monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios
  • Strong experience with enterprise monitoring platforms like SolarWinds
  • Proficiency in bash scripting and Linux system administration (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu preferred)
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka for real-time data processing
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability across Linux systems, storage infrastructure, applications, and network platforms
  • Understanding of metrics collection, time-series data management, and data-driven decision-making
  • Experience implementing AI/ML-based monitoring solutions or anomaly detection systems
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced, complex environments
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes monitoring
  • Proficiency in Python or Go for custom tooling development
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native monitoring services
  • Experience with observability backends such as OpenTelemetry.
  • Knowledge of application performance monitoring (APM) tools
  • Experience with incident response and post-mortem processes
  • Certification in relevant areas (e.g., Kubernetes, cloud platforms, monitoring tools)
  • Contribution to open-source monitoring projects

Required Technical Skills

  • Monitoring Platforms: Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, SolarWinds
  • Data Streaming: Apache Kafka, event processing pipelines
  • AI Monitoring: Anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, ML-based insights
  • Scripting Languages: Bash, Python, Go
  • Operating Systems: Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu), system administration
  • Infrastructure: Storage systems, networking, application monitoring
  • Data Visualization: Grafana dashboards, custom visualizations
  • Cloud & Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (optional but valuable)

What Were Looking For

We seek a hands-on Engineer who is passionate about observability and excellence. Ideal candidates will: Balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical expertise; Team player; Possess strong written and verbal communication skills; Approach challenges with creativity and persistence; Stay current with evolving monitoring and observability technologies

Job Req Type: Experienced

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Devices Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on shift technical authority for high volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Windows 10/11 device transition, Intune/Endpoint Manager re enrolment patterns and Autopilot/Entra join-state activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands on leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Autopilot registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Autopilot profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Autopilot where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provision coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Autopilot/Intune escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Must Have (or Equivalent Experience)

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Windows device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11 provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Windows Autopilot (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Microsoft Entra ID device identity/join states (Entra joined / hybrid joined / registered concepts) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post cutover issues.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD 102, MS 102, SC 300 or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
  • ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids heroics that compromise repeatability.
  • Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
  • Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad hoc fixes.
  • Confident challenging readiness gaps ( not ready to migrate ) using evidence and agreed criteria.
  • Builds trust quickly with cross functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
  • Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
  • Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
  • Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.
  • Quality: first time success rate and defect/rework rate (failed enrolments, repeat tickets).
  • MTTR: mean time to restore/resolve for migration blocking device issues.
  • Evidence capture completeness: percentage of migrations with full log/audit package attached.
  • SLA adherence: on time completion of scheduled waves and timely escalation of blockers.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

Monitoring & Observability Engineering

  • Configure infrastructure, application, database, middleware, network, and Kubernetes monitoring.

  • Create custom monitoring extensions and automation workflows using Dynatrace APIs.

  • Develop AI-driven monitoring use cases utilizing Dynatrace Davis AI for anomaly detection and root cause analysis.

ServiceNow Integration & Event Management

  • Design, implement, and support integration between Dynatrace and ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management platforms.

  • Configure automated incident creation, event correlation, deduplication, and alert enrichment.

  • Implement bidirectional synchronization between Dynatrace events and ServiceNow incidents.

  • Integrate monitoring events with CMDB, Service Mapping, and Event Management workflows.

  • Develop event handling standards, escalation workflows, suppression policies, and alert tuning strategies to reduce noise and improve operational efficiency.

Dashboard & Reporting Engineering

  • Design and develop executive, operational, and technical dashboards using Dynatrace Dashboards

  • Create business service health dashboards, application performance dashboards, SLA reporting dashboards, and infrastructure monitoring views.

  • Develop advanced visualizations for:

  • Provide meaningful insights and recommendations through data visualization and reporting.

Automation & Integration

  • Automate monitoring onboarding, dashboard creation, alert configuration, and reporting activities.

  • Integrate Dynatrace with enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, Splunk, CyberArk, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services.

  • Utilize REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code practices for monitoring automation.

Operational Support & Governance

  • Monitor platform performance, capacity, availability, and data ingestion health.

  • Troubleshoot monitoring gaps, agent issues, integration failures, and dashboard performance concerns.

  • Define monitoring standards, governance policies, and operational best practices.

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, SOPs, technical runbooks, and knowledge articles.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements by maintaining monitoring evidence and reporting controls.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Overall 8+ years of IT experience.

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Dynatrace administration and observability engineering.

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience integrating monitoring platforms with ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale monitoring environments across infrastructure and application landscapes.

  • Experience in SaaS-based observability platforms and cloud monitoring solutions.

  • Strong experience working with Linux/RHEL environments.

  • Demonstrates advanced troubleshooting skills, analytical approach, and expertise in root-cause analysis within complex distributed environments.

  • Experience operating within regulated industries, preferably banking or financial services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

  • Experience with Observability, AIOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.

  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, and Hybrid Cloud monitoring.

jobDescription:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Agile Project Manager - iTakeControl to join our global team. This role will be fully onsite at our Pune office. There may be flexibility to transition to a hybrid work model in the future, based on business requirements.


Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.


At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a Great Place to Work".


How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.

Job Overview

iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in-house and building the team that will own and grow it.


We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager to own delivery and be the bridge between the business and the engineering team. You will balance two priorities: coordinating the delivery of the platform to clients including configuring and launching new clinical studies and driving the ongoing development of the product. The immediate focus is keeping client delivery running smoothly; as that settles into a steady cadence, the role grows to take on more of the process governance-Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.


This is a delivery-accountable role for someone who can translate between business and technical teams, keep priorities clear, and make sure the right work ships at the right time. It works closely with US-based stakeholders and requires daily overlap with US hours.

What Youll Own

  • Client delivery own the end-to-end delivery and configuration of the platform for clients, getting new studies live and supported on time and within compliance
  • Product delivery own the teams delivery rhythm: prioritization, planning, and release coordination for the core platform in collaboration with the Product management team
  • The bridge intake the feature requirements, enhancement requests from product team and create the realistic development plan in collaboration with the engineering team, and keep both sides aligned on what comes first and why
  • Priority calls make and communicate the trade-offs when client delivery and product work compete for the same people
  • Delivery health track and report progress using meaningful flow metrics, and surface risks early with options
  • Process efficiency - As the engineering team matures, build efficiency KPIs for teams delivery and quality performance.

You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns coordination and delivery.


What Were Looking For

Experience and Mindset

  • 7+ years managing software delivery, with a strong track record of shipping on time
  • Proven experience owning client-facing delivery or implementation not only internal product work
  • Strong agile background, with the judgement to choose and adapt the right approach for the team rather than applying one framework by rote (we are not tied to a single methodology)
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines
  • A natural translator between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, who can negotiate realistic plans between the two
  • Strong ownership instincts accountable for outcomes, not just facilitation
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills builds trust quickly across clients, leadership, and the engineering team, and keeps everyone informed and aligned
  • Stays composed under pressure keeps a clear head and a steady hand when priorities collide, deadlines tighten, or issues escalate, and brings the team along calmly
  • Clear, honest communicator who brings problems forward early

Clinical and Regulatory

  • Life sciences background is essential experience delivering software in clinical trials, healthcare IT, pharma, medical devices, or an equivalent regulated environment
  • Understanding of what it means to deliver within a validated, GxP-compliant system change control, data integrity, and the discipline a regulated environment demands

Technical Fluency

  • Enough technical fluency to coordinate engineering work credibly understand dependencies, ask the right questions, and challenge estimates (you do not need to write code)
  • Comfortable with standard delivery and collaboration tooling, and open to AI-assisted tools that speed up planning and reporting

Education and Experience



  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • 7+ years in software project / delivery management, including client-facing delivery and/or Scrum Master roles
  • 3+ years leading delivery for an engineering team
  • 3+ years within regulated or validated software environments (clinical, GxP, FDA, HIPAA, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  • Agile and/or project management certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent) a plus
  • Experience in enterprise Agile transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD processes.
  • Direct experience with a clinical trial / patient engagement / eCOA platform preferred


This job description captures the essential functions of this role as of July 2026. Management reserves the right to modify it as the platform and team evolve.

  • Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs focused on healthy lifestyles
  • Generous paid time off, employee assistance programs and flexible work arrangements
  • Performance driven environment including professional development and transfer opportunities

  • Celebrations! We love to celebrate service anniversaries, holidays, diversity and inclusion events, project milestones and anything else that is meaningful to our employees

  • Ongoing programs and events designed to bring our global team together
